trainer.name: Coach Faizan Khan
trainer.shortBio: Coach Faizan Khan has pioneered a revolutionary 12-level conversational fluency framework that eliminates fear, corrects grammar naturally, and cultivates executive boardroom charisma.
trainer.fullBio: Coach Faizan Khan is an acclaimed Communication Specialist, Corporate Voice Coach, and Founder-Director of GLOBAL Institute. Over the past 12 years, he has personally trained more than 15,000 students, working professionals, school educators, and corporate executives. His high-impact, activity-based methodology replaces rote grammar drills with instinctive conversation practice, empowering anyone—from complete beginners to ambitious professionals—to speak English with authority, poise, and natural fluency.
